verdict.rationale: Everything you can do in the playground, the API also covers: chat completions, streaming, structured outputs, tool calling, vision, batch and service tiers. A Management API also handles fine-tuned model uploads and deployment for dedicated endpoints. However, the Cloud Console manages projects, API keys, usage, billing and team access, and nothing shows these are available programmatically; the probe also found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: API equivalents for console management (projects, API keys, usage, billing, team access), a published OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation of UI/API parity.
